signup.trial: Try Liwan free for 14 days. No payment card required.
signup.smsSent: Enter the code we sent by SMS to {destination}.
signup.emailSent: Enter the code we sent to {destination}.
signup.emailDestination: We’ll use {destination} to verify your email address.
signup.invitation: You’ll get an invitation at {email} within a few minutes, and you set your password from it.
signup.invitationLate: If it hasn’t arrived after ten minutes, wait a little and check your spam folder. We keep preparing your workspace even if it runs late, and we’ll send the invitation to the same address. You don’t need to call us.

errors.businessEmailRequired: Use your company email address. Free email providers such as Gmail or Outlook are not accepted.
errors.mobileInvalid: Enter a Saudi mobile number, such as 0500000000.
errors.codeFormat: Enter the six digits from the verification message.
errors.termsRequired: Accept the Terms of Service and the Privacy Policy to continue.
errors.termsChanged: The terms have changed. Please review the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy, then accept them again.
errors.invalid: Check your registration details and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is incorrect or has expired. Check the code or request a new one.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
errors.unavailable: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.trialAlreadyUsed: Your company has already used its free trial. Sign in to your existing workspace, or ask your company's account administrator to invite you. If a different company shares this email domain, contact the LiwanOS team.
errors.expired: Your registration session has expired. Start again below.
errors.humanCheckFailed: The security check did not pass. Complete it again, then try once more.
errors.humanCheckUnavailable: We could not reach the security check, so we cannot send an SMS right now. Try again in a few minutes.
